outputs.www/assets/moon_south_cap.jpg: greyscale, azimuthal equidistant 75S-90S, bicubic resampling, percentile stretch, denoise sigma 1.2 px, local-contrast (Gaussian sigma 90 px, 0.30), tone map 0.10-0.92, unsharp mask r=1.6

effective_resolution_note: Source latitude sampling 22.8 px/deg (~1.33 km/px); the cap image is upsampled and cannot show detail finer than the source.
use: Visual orientation only; not used in any calculation.
obtained_via: Public mirror of the unmodified NASA file (github.com/akshaj99/MoonVis, data/lroc_color_poles_8k.tif) because svs.gsfc.nasa.gov was not reachable from the build environment.
verification: Downsampled to 2048x1024 and compared with lroc_color_poles_2k from the same SVS kit: Pearson r = 0.994, mean |diff| = 2.3 / 255 (JPEG recompression). Re-download from SVS and compare SHA-256 before publication.
